places.name: Strasbourg Cathedral (Notre-Dame)
places.ai_summary: A masterpiece of Gothic architecture, featuring stunning stained glass windows and a towering spire.

opening_hours.notes: Climb the tower for panoramic views of the city.

places.place_tip: Visit during the golden hour for the best photos of the facade.

attribution.title: La Meinau en National
attribution.author: Xaviyeah

places.name: La Petite France Quarter
places.ai_summary: A picturesque historic district with half-timbered houses, cobblestone streets, and canals.

opening_hours.notes: Shops and cafes may have specific opening hours.

places.place_tip: Take a boat tour to explore the canals and learn about the history of the area.

attribution.title: Strasbourg Petite-France place Benjamin-Zix septembre 2015
attribution.author: Photo Claude TRUONG-NGOC
attribution.description: Strasbourg Petite-France maison des Tanneurs et place Benjamin-Zix

places.name: Palais Rohan
places.ai_summary: A grand palace housing three museums: the Museum of Decorative Arts, the Archaeological Museum, and the Museum of Fine Arts.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays and public holidays.

places.place_tip: Check for temporary exhibitions during your visit.

places.name: European Parliament
places.ai_summary: The seat of the European Parliament, an impressive modern building with a distinctive circular chamber.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours available in multiple languages.

places.place_tip: Book a guided tour in advance to learn about the EU's functions and visit the hemicycle chamber.

attribution.title: Plaque commémorant l'inauguration de l'immeuble Louise Weiss du Parlement Européen à Strasbourg, le 14 décembre 1999
attribution.author: https://www.flickr.com/photos/cmoi/
attribution.description: Plaque commemorating the inauguration of the Louise Weiss Building of the European Parliament in Strasbourg on December 14, 1999, by President of France, Jacques Chirac, and President of the European Parliament, Nicole Fontaine.

places.name: Barrage Vauban
places.ai_summary: A historic dam and lock system with a covered bridge, offering scenic views and boat access.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the day for views of the locks in operation.

places.place_tip: Walk across the covered bridge for great views of the dam and the city.

attribution.title: Strasbourg Barrage Vauban après restauration 2012-01
attribution.author: Claude TRUONG-NGOC
attribution.description: Strasbourg le barrage Vauban après sa restauration en 2012.

places.name: Place Kléber
places.ai_summary: The central square of Strasbourg, surrounded by shops, cafes, and historic buildings.

opening_hours.notes: Shops and cafes have varying hours.

places.place_tip: Visit the Christmas market here if you're in Strasbourg during the holiday season.

places.name: Musée Alsacien
places.ai_summary: A museum dedicated to Alsatian culture and history, featuring traditional costumes, artifacts, and exhibits.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays and public holidays.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the reconstructed Alsatian house and the beautiful courtyard.

attribution.title: Cour-Musée alsacien
attribution.author: Ji-Elle
attribution.description: Cour intérieure du Musée alsacien de Strasbourg

places.name: Palais des Rohan Museums
places.ai_summary: A complex of three museums in the former Rohan Palace: the Museum of Decorative Arts, the Archaeological Museum, and the Museum of Fine Arts.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays and public holidays.

places.place_tip: Check for temporary exhibitions during your visit.
places.address: Palais des Rohan Museums, Strasbourg, France

places.name: Orangerie Park
places.ai_summary: A large public park with beautiful gardens, a lake, and the Strasbourg Zoo.

opening_hours.notes: Zoo has separate opening hours and entry fee.

places.place_tip: Visit the stork park within the Orangerie for a unique experience.

attribution.title: County Cork - Fota House-Orangery - 20180910130154
attribution.author: Rosanne Donovan

places.name: Saint-Thomas Church
places.ai_summary: A Protestant church known for its impressive organ and beautiful stained glass windows.
places.place_tip: Attend a concert if possible, to experience the organ music in this beautiful setting.

places.name: Ponts Couverts
places.ai_summary: Historic covered bridges that are a symbol of Strasbourg, offering great views of the city and the river.

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed at sunrise or sunset for stunning photos.

places.place_tip: Explore the area around the bridges for unique perspectives and photo opportunities.

places.name: Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art
places.ai_summary: A museum showcasing modern and contemporary art, with works by famous artists and rotating exhibitions.
places.name_english: Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays and public holidays.

places.place_tip: Check the museum's schedule for special exhibitions and events.
places.address: 1 Place Hans Jean Arp, 67000 Strasbourg, France

attribution.author: Sniper Zeta
attribution.description: Strasbourg Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art, Strasbourg, Alsace, France

places.name: Maison Kammerzell
places.ai_summary: A historic building with a beautifully decorated facade, now housing a restaurant.
places.cost: Free to enter, cost of meals varies
places.place_tip: Try the local Alsatian dishes in this historic setting.
places.address: 16 Place de la Cathédrale, 67000 Strasbourg, France

places.name: Boat Cruise on the Ill River
places.ai_summary: A relaxing boat cruise on the Ill River, offering unique views of Strasbourg's landmarks.
places.cost: Varies by cruise length and provider

opening_hours.notes: Book in advance, especially during peak tourist season.

places.place_tip: Choose a cruise that offers commentary for a more informative experience.

places.name: Neustadt District
places.ai_summary: A district known for its German-style architecture, wide boulevards, and the beautiful Place de la République.

opening_hours.notes: Explore on foot or by bike for the best experience.

places.place_tip: Visit the district's cafes and bakeries for a taste of local life.

attribution.title: Avenue de la liberté (43633488914)
attribution.author: Valentin R. from France
attribution.usage_terms: Creative Commons Zero, Public Domain Dedication
attribution.description: L'ancienne rue de l'Empereur Guillaume est bordé de très beaux batîments ayant chacun leur histoire. Mais même la rue a une histoire. Elle fait la jonction directe entre l'ancien Palais de l'Empereur et le Palais Universitaire. Cela avait pour but de mettre en avant que l'Empereur était attentif à l'Éducation (et à l'éventuel contre-pouvoir que cela pourrait générer).

places.name: Opera National du Rhin
places.ai_summary: The national opera house of Alsace, offering a variety of performances including opera, ballet, and concerts.

opening_hours.notes: Check the schedule for performance times and ticket availability.

places.place_tip: Book tickets in advance for popular performances.
places.address: Place de la République, 67000 Strasbourg, France

places.name: Rue des Juifs
places.ai_summary: A historic street in the La Petite France district, known for its well-preserved medieval buildings.

opening_hours.notes: Explore the area on foot to fully appreciate the architecture.

places.place_tip: Visit the nearby Alsatian Museum to learn more about the region's history.

places.name: Botanical Gardens of Strasbourg
places.ai_summary: A beautiful garden featuring a wide variety of plants, trees, and flowers, as well as a small lake.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in spring and summer when the flowers are in bloom.

places.place_tip: Bring a picnic to enjoy in the gardens, and don't miss the orchid greenhouse.
places.address: Jardin des Deux Rives, 67000 Strasbourg, France

places.name: Alsatian Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum dedicated to the history and culture of Alsace, with exhibits on local traditions, crafts, and daily life.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays and public holidays.

places.place_tip: Look out for the stork symbol, which represents the region of Alsace.
